name: ink
title: Ink engine
description: Looseleaf's hand-drawing engine: seeded randomness, pens, shapes, fills, the <Ink> layer, the provider and the grain and paper textures shared by every drawn component.

files.content:
export type * from '@/lib/ink/types'
export * from '@/lib/ink/rng'
export * from '@/lib/ink/noise'
export * from '@/lib/ink/paint'
export * from '@/lib/ink/geom'
export * from '@/lib/ink/pens'
export * from '@/lib/ink/pen'
export * from '@/lib/ink/shapes'
export * from '@/lib/ink/fills'
export * from '@/lib/ink/builder'
export * from '@/lib/ink/recipes'
export {
  InkDefs, InkProvider, InkContext, InkSvg, Ink as InkLayer, ensureInkDefs, useEnsureInkDefs, mergeRefs, useDensity, useInk, useInkBox, useInkContext, useInkCore, useInkKnobs, useInkScope,
  useInkSeed, useInkTier, useMergedRef, frameKey, frameSvg, inkCache, inkFrame,
} from '@/lib/ink/react'
export type { InkProviderProps, InkProps, InkContextValue, InkHostProps, InkScopeProps, UseInkOptions, UseInkResult, Frame, FrameRequest } from '@/lib/ink/react'

export { InkDefs, InkTiles, ensureInkDefs } from "@/lib/ink/react/defs"
export { useEnsureInkDefs } from "@/lib/ink/react/ensure-defs"
export { IconSizeContext, useIconSize } from "@/lib/ink/react/icon-size"
export { InkProvider, type InkProviderProps } from "@/lib/ink/react/provider"
export { Ink, type InkProps } from "@/lib/ink/react/ink-layer"
export { InkSvg } from "@/lib/ink/react/svg"
export {
  InkContext, DEFAULT_INK_CONTEXT, mergeRefs, useDensity, useInk, useInkBox, useInkContext, useInkCore, useInkKnobs, useInkScope, useInkSeed, useInkTier, useMergedRef,
  type InkContextValue, type InkHostProps, type InkScopeProps, type UseInkCore, type UseInkOptions, type UseInkResult,
} from "@/lib/ink/react/hooks"
export { frameKey, frameSvg, inkCache, inkFrame, type Frame, type FrameRequest } from "@/lib/ink/react/cache"
export { INK_LAYER_ORDER, bucketBox } from "@/lib/ink/recipes"

import type { PaintKey } from '@/lib/ink/paint'

export type Pt = [number, number]

export type BBox = [number, number, number, number]

export type Tier = 'hi' | 'lo'

export type Material = 'under' | 'wash' | 'hl' | 'marker' | 'pencil' | 'waxy' | 'text' | 'felt' | 'stamp' | 'top'

export type LayerName = 'rest' | 'hover' | 'pressed' | 'focus' | 'disabled' | 'invalid' | 'checked' | 'indeterminate' | 'open' | 'busy'

export type GrainKind = 'felt' | 'marker' | 'graphite' | 'waxy' | 'stamp'

export type PenKind = 'felt' | 'pencil' | 'marker' | 'hl'

export type WeightClass = 'fine' | 'std' | 'brush'

export type Accent = 'tomato' | 'tangerine' | 'lemon' | 'grass' | 'teal' | 'sky' | 'grape' | 'bubblegum'

export type BasePenName = 'ink' | 'blue' | 'redfelt' | 'greenfelt' | 'focus' | 'pencil' | 'red' | 'green' | 'orange' | 'bluepencil'
export type PenName = BasePenName | `${BasePenName}.${'fine' | 'brush'}` | 'terracotta' | 'hi' | `m_${Accent}` | `f_${Accent}`

export interface PenSpec {
  kind: PenKind
  color: PaintKey
  grain: GrainKind
  cls: WeightClass
  W: number
  alpha: number
  wob: { amp: number; wl: number; tr: number }
  step: number
  halo: number
  bleed: number
  core: number
  pool: number
  feather: number
  skip: number
  swell: number
  dir: number
  dryAmt: number
  dryWl: number
  gaps: number
  dens: number
  taper: number
  smear: number
  waxy: boolean
  nib: number
  edge: number
  wet: number
  cutK: number
}

export interface StrokeOpts {
  tier?: Tier
  wobble?: number
  speed?: number
  start?: 'pool' | 'soft'
  end?: 'pool' | 'flick' | 'soft'
  width?: number
  alpha?: number
  color?: PaintKey
  poly?: boolean
  round?: number
  raw?: boolean
  dry?: number
  press?: (t: number) => number
  simple?: boolean
}

export interface RibbonLayer {
  k: 'halo' | 'hair' | 'body' | 'core' | 'pool' | 'smear' | 'rim' | 'streak'
  d: string
  fill: PaintKey
  op: number
  rule?: 'evenodd'
}

export interface StrokeResult {
  kind: PenKind
  layers: RibbonLayer[]
  bbox: BBox
  len: number
  start: Pt
  end: Pt
}

export interface Line {
  pts: Pt[]
  o?: StrokeOpts
  pen?: PenName
}
